title: Hiring People with Disabilities - Internship & Full-Time Roles
desc:
Transforming the Future with the Power of Unique Perspectives!
At Philip Morris Türkiye, we value the richness of different backgrounds and experiences. We evaluate our colleagues based on their talents and potential, creating an environment where everyone can thrive. We believe that our differences make us stronger, more creative, and more successful.
We are looking for new team members who want to be part of our unique culture where everyone’s ideas are valued, contributions are meaningful and supported.
Who We’re Looking For
We are seeking candidates registered with the Turkish Employment Agency (İŞKUR) and have at least a 40% disability report,
for intern or professional positions!
University Student Candidates
If you are a university student and want to take your first step into the professional world:
Have a good level of English,
Participate in the internship program at least 2.5 days a week,
Have communication, teamwork, and analytical thinking skills,
Graduate And Experienced Candidates
If you want to steer your career or share your experiences with us, we invite you to join our team. If you are:
Available to work full-time,
Have a good level of English,
Solution-oriented, a team player, and have strong communication skills,
Desire to develop yourself and showcase your professional skills,
Adapt to a work culture that values collaboration and shared success
We evaluate candidates ready to make a difference with their experiences in various fields and aim to place them in suitable positions.
What We Offer
Our success depends on our talented employees who come to work here every single day with a sense of purpose and an appetite for progress. Join PMI and you too can:
Seize the freedom to shape your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore.
Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business –our staggering size and scale provides endless opportunities to progress.
A supportive work environment: A culture centered on respect and mutual support,
Flexible and responsive working arrangements: Solutions that will make your life easier,
Comprehensive benefits: Advantages for both your professional and personal needs,
Continuous development opportunities: Trainings and projects where you can develop yourself,
Long-term career opportunities: A journey that supports your goals and rewards your contributions.
Your application will be evaluated based on your competencies and career goals, and we will contact you for the most suitable positions. If you want to give a new direction to your career or start with an internship experience, we are waiting for your application!
Apply now and let’s build a brighter future together!
